Carmen presented the [first paper of DEBIAS](https://de-bias.github.io/debias/publications/2025/preprint-quantifying-bias/) at the [British Society for Population Studies (BSPS) Conference](https://www.lse.ac.uk/international-development/research/british-society-for-population-studies/annual-conference), held in Swansea from the 2nd - 4th of September 2025.
